title: Leads workspace
facts: Manage enquiries from the Leads workspace: search and filter your leads, review ownership and sales stages, then open a lead to see its details, activities and follow-ups.
Start with the lead list, check the assigned owner and status, and open the lead to record customer interactions and plan the next follow-up. Available actions depend on your account permissions.
source: Leadrat Pre-Sales handbook, Lead Management, page 7; src/app/features/leads/leads.routes.ts

title: Add a lead
facts: Add Lead opens a new lead form. Contact details, source and configured requirements are entered here. Required fields depend on your CRM configuration.
This demonstration opens the form and shows visible contact fields. It does not submit the form or create a record.

title: Lead sources
facts: Lead source and sub-source record where an enquiry originated. Available values depend on your organisation configuration.

The CRM source includes integration settings as well as manual entry and bulk upload. Availability of a specific provider requires configuration and verification; this demo does not connect external accounts.

title: Bulk lead upload
facts: The Leads module includes a bulk-upload screen. Use the template and validation guidance visible there to prepare an import.
This demonstration only opens the import screen. It does not select a file, upload data or start an import.

title: Projects workspace
facts: Projects organises project information. The CRM includes project details, blocks and units, amenities and a gallery.
This demonstration opens the project list. Account permissions determine which projects and actions are available.

title: Tasks workspace
facts: The Tasks workspace manages task records. Priority, status and scheduling controls depend on the task form and account permissions.
This demonstration opens Tasks. It does not create, complete or reassign a task.

title: Properties workspace
facts: The Properties module provides the property workspace. Available listings and controls depend on permissions.
This demonstration opens the module; it does not modify inventory or publish a listing.

title: Dashboard
facts: The Dashboard provides the CRM overview. Visible widgets and figures depend on your organisation and permissions.
This demonstration opens the dashboard without interpreting customer-specific figures.

title: Lead communication
facts: The CRM source contains lead email and WhatsApp communication workflows. Sending depends on configuration, permissions and the chosen communication channel.
This browser adapter currently demonstrates the Leads entry point only. It cannot yet verify the nested communication workflow and will not send messages.

title: Lead status
facts: Lead status is part of lead management. The available status values and permitted transitions depend on your CRM configuration.
This browser adapter currently shows the Leads entry point. Status editing is not enabled in this read-only demonstration.

title: Global Config screen
facts: Global Config is the central Pre-Sales configuration area for tenant-wide masters and behaviour used by Leads, Data, Projects, Properties, Listings and Tasks.
It holds lead status and substatus masters, lead source references, custom fields, reason masters, activity masters and project/property option values.
This demonstration opens the Global Config screen only; it does not create or change any configuration.
source: Leadrat Pre-Sales handbook, Global Config, page 3; src/app/layout/left-nav/left-nav.component.ts; src/app/features/global-config

title: Data Management workspace
facts: Data Management handles bulk prospect datasets before or alongside active lead work, including import, field mapping, validation, filters, segmentation and controlled assignment.
It is separate from the Leads workspace, which holds active leads.
This demonstration opens the Data screen only; it does not import, assign or change records.
source: Leadrat Pre-Sales handbook, Data Management, page 9; src/app/layout/left-nav/left-nav.component.ts; src/app/features/data-management

title: Attendance screen
facts: Attendance records Clock In and Clock Out events for Pre-Sales users and gives managers visibility into attendance within their team scope.
Location validation applies only where the tenant enables it.
This demonstration opens the Attendance screen only; it does not clock anyone in or out.
source: Leadrat Pre-Sales handbook, Attendance, page 19; src/app/layout/left-nav/left-nav.component.ts; src/app/features/attendance

title: Users and Teams screen
facts: Users & Teams controls user accounts, team hierarchy, roles and permissions, module access and record visibility for Pre-Sales users.
Deactivating a user keeps historical ownership, unlike deleting.
This demonstration opens the Team screen only; it does not add, edit or deactivate users.
source: Leadrat Pre-Sales handbook, Team - Users & Teams, page 23; src/app/layout/left-nav/left-nav.component.ts; src/app/features/teams

title: Org Profile screen
facts: Org Profile stores organisation-level identity such as the organisation name, contact details, brand/logo and business location where supported.
Feature masters such as lead status and source belong to Global Config, and user access belongs to Users & Teams.
This demonstration opens the Org Profile screen only; it does not change organisation details.
source: Leadrat Pre-Sales handbook, Org Profile, page 25; src/app/layout/left-nav/left-nav.component.ts; src/app/features/profile

title: Leadrat AI page
facts: The Leadrat AI page explains how supported AI clients such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini can connect to Leadrat capabilities through the MCP integration, and which capabilities are available.
AI actions remain subject to the user's Leadrat permissions; the external AI client provides the conversational intelligence.
This demonstration opens the Leadrat AI page only; it does not connect any AI client.
source: Leadrat Pre-Sales handbook, Leadrat AI - MCP Introduction Page, page 27; src/app/layout/left-nav/left-nav.component.ts; src/app/features/leadrat-ai
